data.name: Mountain Resort Manager
data.detailed_description:
Settle into a cozy mountain management sim where your resort grows from a quiet slope to a thriving alpine village. Lay out trails and lifts, place buildings for food, lodging and more and watch guests carve their way across the landscape. Every decision shapes the flow of the day: staffing levels, pricing, and research choices influence your finances and the guest experience.

This is a game about gentle growth and steady stewardship. Expand at your own pace, keep an eye on budgets, and balance convenience with charm as your resort evolves through the seasons. Whether you are chasing a perfect layout or simply enjoying the view, the mountain is yours to shape.

Design ski slopes and hiking trails across a living terrain where snow falls, melts, and accumulates with the weather. Upgrade from a humble magic carpet to high-speed gondolas, place cozy cabins or grand hotels, and fill the village with bakeries, bars, and fine dining. As your resort attracts more guests, invest in research, hire specialized staff, and adapt your strategy season by season - because a thriving summer hiking destination needs a different touch than a packed winter ski resort.

Key Features

  • Shape the Mountain - Draw slopes and trails freely across the terrain.

  • Build a Lift Network - Progress from magic carpets and T-bars to quad chairs and high-speed gondolas, each with its own capacity, speed, and range.

  • Grow Your Village - Place over 20 building types: lodging, food, retail, entertainment, and services - each with operating hours, capacity, and pricing you control.

  • Manage Through the Seasons - Snow accumulates in winter and melts in spring. Deploy snow cannons and groomers to extend the season, then shift to hiking, biking, and paragliding in summer.

  • Staff Your Resort - Hire medics, guides, and maintenance workers, each with distinct responsibilities to keep your resort running smoothly.

  • Research and Invest - Unlock many research projects across three tiers to improve marketing, lift speeds, staff training, snow retention, and more.

  • Run the Business - Set seasonal rates, launch marketing campaigns, and track your finances through a detailed ledger as you grow.

  • Watch Guests Live Their Day - Guests arrive with their own skill levels, budgets, and preferences.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Sound Card: any

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
